mapper.insert: insert into a2a_rate_limit_windows(tenant_id,policy_id,window_started_at,request_count,updated_at) values(#{tenantId},#{policyId},#{windowStartedAt},1,now()) on conflict(tenant_id,policy_id,window_started_at) do update set request_count=a2a_rate_limit_windows.request_count+1,updated_at=now()
mapper.select: select request_count from a2a_rate_limit_windows where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and policy_id=#{policyId} and window_started_at=#{windowStartedAt}
